issues: 形容词只有 ~60px 的居中单列，四周大面积空场，没有任何品牌或上下文，读不出是在展示什么
胶囊是一条固定 900px 的长条，词只占一半，右侧大块空色块
选中判定跟整数拍走：跳变时新词还在胶囊下方就先变成反白色，穿帮
换主题只换颜色，五个形容词字体完全一样，"多种气质"讲不出来
changes: 版式改成一句话：静止细体「Make it」(132px/300) + 胶囊里的形容词，读作 Make it modern → playful → expressive → BOLD → yours.，最后一拍落在口号上
胶囊改成透镜：外层统一暗白列表，胶囊里是裁切副本（深色字 + 该主题字体：无衬线 / 圆体 / 衬线斜体 / 全大写 Futura），词越过胶囊边缘才换色换体
胶囊宽度跟选中词实测字宽、与色 / 场 / 行同一个拍内时钟插值；squash 改为竖 1.14 / 横反相 0.97 的体积守恒弹 + 接住瞬间同色辉光
节奏 3 拍→4 拍（18f/拍，6f 陡 ease-out 跳变 + 12f 静置），140f；开场 16f 由虚到实入场，全程 1.0→1.03 极缓推镜
五套深场同明度异色相（浓缩→深梅→深靛→深青→海军蓝），胶囊同色大光晕跟场同拍换；列表按行距衰减 + 远行虚化做滚轮景深
加品牌 Quire、THEME 03/05 计数与五枚色票（元素层挂同一整数拍），末拍后口号「One system. Every mood.」逐词升起
issuesEn: The adjectives were a ~60px centred column floating in empty space, with no brand or context to say what was being shown
The pill was a fixed 900px bar with the word filling only half of it, leaving a large empty block of colour
Selection followed the integer beat, so during the jump the incoming word turned dark while still below the pill
Each theme only changed colour; every adjective used the same typeface, so 'many personalities' never came across
changesEn: The layout is now one sentence: a static light 'Make it' (132px/300) plus the adjective in the pill, reading Make it modern, playful, expressive, BOLD, yours., landing on the tagline

The pill is a lens: outside is one dim white list, inside is a clipped copy in dark ink and the theme's typeface (sans, rounded, serif italic, uppercase Futura), so words change only as they cross the pill edge

Pill width follows the measured width of the selected word on the same in-beat clock as colour, field and row; squash is now a volume-preserving 1.14 vertical / 0.97 horizontal pop with a glow on catch
Rhythm goes from 3 to 4 beats (18f per beat, 6f steep ease-out jump, 12f still), 140f total, with a 16f blur-in opening and a 1.0 to 1.03 slow push throughout

Five deep fields of equal lightness and different hue (espresso, plum, indigo, teal, navy) with a large pill-coloured glow that changes on the beat; the list fades and blurs by row distance for wheel-like depth
Added the Quire brand, a THEME 03/05 counter and five swatches on the same integer beat (element layer only), and the tagline 'One system. Every mood.' rising word by word after the last beat
